install.notes: The card's install block names no install command. The fake backend and the acceptance gate are pure Python and need neither MuJoCo nor the upstream package; the task environment pins mujoco==3.9.0 (task1_mujoco/robotiq_duo_full_scene_minimal_core/environment.yml:20), which is only needed to serve the model with the real engine (backend sim), and that path was not run here. The task card marks the package as GPU-capable; the fake does not use a GPU.
